'''Deathspine varactyls''' were a type of [[Varactyl/Legends|varactyl]] that lived on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. They could be found in the jungles near the city of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], where the planet wasn't completely covered with kilometer-high [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]].

During the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a Deathspine varactyl was held within the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Cog Hive Seven]] and in [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], the creature was released from it by the [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]&mdash;a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who had infiltrated the prison as an inmate. Maul proceeded to ride the creature across the prison concourse and then [[Death/Legends|killed]] the beast, and afterward he gave the varactyl's skull to the [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] prisoner [[Coyle]] in exchange for Coyle's services as a counterfeiter.<ref name="Lockdown">''[[Maul: Lockdown]]''</ref>
